note: Wexford County (26165) publishes its parcel map only through the Schneider Beacon viewer (Cloudflare-protected, no public ArcGIS REST service found) plus a GIS data fee and license schedule (2009_GIS_Fees_NEW.pdf, Wexford_County_Data_Licensing_Agreement.pdf). ArcGIS Hub/Online searches found no Wexford parcel service. The only parcel FeatureServer found (services7.arcgis.com/1wa3ar4YCngv5mgE) holds Dumfries, Virginia data. Commercial vendors (reportallusa, regrid, equatorstudios) sell Wexford parcels but are not county-published services.
